title: Website Chatbot for Small Business
description:
Visitors of a small business website ask the same questions again and again: shipping costs, delivery times, returns, opening hours, prices. A simple chatbot should answer these from a knowledge base that the owner maintains, and point to a contact address when it does not know the answer.

Constraints

  • Easy to set up and maintain without a developer: the knowledge base is one file.
  • Low or no running costs; works on a static website.
  • Must not invent answers: unknown questions get a fallback with contact details.
  • Works on mobile and desktop and fits the site's design.
goals:
• The 20 most frequent customer questions are answered correctly in a test with paraphrased questions.
  • Unknown questions get the fallback answer instead of a wrong answer in at least 95 % of test cases.
  • Answer shown in under one second.
  • Setup on an existing website in under an hour.
